t: The TRACER Fine Tip Black Permanent Marker is a high-performance marker pen designed for clear, long-lasting identification on tough surfaces. The solvent-based marker features a durable 1-2mm acrylic bullet tip designed to resist wear on the jobsite. It is ideal for carpenters, plumbers and DIYers marking out cuts on wood, tiles, metal and plastics. Quick-drying black ink minimizes smudging for clean, dependable marking, while the compact 90mm uncapped length supports easy everyday carry. The lanyard-compatible cap keeps the pen readily accessible.
b: Durable Acrylic Tip for Tough Worksites
Precise 1-2mm Bullet Tip for Clear Lines
Ideal for Wood, Tiles, Metal & Plastics
